--authenticationDatabase.Name: --authenticationDatabase
--authenticationDatabase.description: Specifies the authentication database where the specified --username has been created. See Authentication Database

--authenticationMechanism.Name: --authenticationMechanism
--authenticationMechanism.description: Specifies the authentication mechanism the MongoDB Shell uses to authenticate to the mongod or mongos

--eval.Name: --eval
--eval.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression that is specified as an argument. mongosh does not load its own environment when evaluating code. As a result many options of the shell environment are not available. The result of evaluating a JavaScript argument is printed to your command line

--gssapiHostName.Name: --gssapiHostName
--gssapiHostName.description: Specify the hostname of a service using GSSAPI/Kerberos. Only required if the hostname of a machine does not match the hostname resolved by DNS

--gssapiServiceName.Name: --gssapiServiceName
--gssapiServiceName.description: Specify the name of the service using GSSAPI/Kerberos. Only required if the service does not use the default name of mongodb

--help.Name: --help
--help.description: Returns information on the options and use of the MongoDB Shell

--nodb.Name: --nodb
--nodb.description: Prevents the shell from connecting to any database instances

--norc.Name: --norc
--norc.description: Prevents the shell from sourcing and evaluating ~/.mongoshrc.js on startup

--password.Name: --password
--password.description: Specifies a password with which to authenticate to a MongoDB database that uses authentication. Use in conjunction with the --username and --authenticationDatabase options

--port.Name: --port
--port.description: Specifies the port where the mongod or mongos instance is listening. If --port is not specified, the MongoDB Shell attempts to connect to port 27017

--quiet.Name: --quiet
--quiet.description: Skips all messages during startup (such as welcome messages and startup warnings) and goes directly to the prompt

--retryWrites.Name: --retryWrites
--retryWrites.description: Enables retryable writes as the default for sessions in the MongoDB Shell

--shell.Name: --shell
--shell.description: Enables the shell interface. If you invoke the mongosh command and specify a JavaScript file as an argument, or use --eval to specify JavaScript on the command line, the --shell option provides the user with a shell prompt after the file finishes executing

--tls.Name: --tls
--tls.description: Enables connection to a mongod or mongos that has TLS SSL support enabled

--tlsAllowInvalidCertificates.Name: --tlsAllowInvalidCertificates
--tlsAllowInvalidCertificates.description: Bypasses the validation checks for the certificates presented by the mongod/mongos instance and allows connections to servers that present invalid certificates

--tlsAllowInvalidHostnames.Name: --tlsAllowInvalidHostnames
--tlsAllowInvalidHostnames.description: Disables the validation of the hostnames in the certificate presented by the mongod/mongos instance. Allows the MongoDB Shell to connect to MongoDB instances even if the hostname in the server certificates do not match the server's host

--tlsCAFile.Name: --tlsCAFile
--tlsCAFile.description: Specifies the .pem file that contains the root certificate chain from the Certificate Authority. This file is used to validate the certificate presented by the mongod/mongos instance

--tlsCRLFile.Name: --tlsCRLFile
--tlsCRLFile.description: Specifies the .pem file that contains the root certificate chain from the Certificate Authority. This file is used to validate the certificate presented by the mongod/mongos instance

--tlsCertificateKeyFile.Name: --tlsCertificateKeyFile
--tlsCertificateKeyFile.description: Enables connection to a mongod or mongos that has TLS SSL support enabled

--username.Name: --username
--username.description: Specifies a username with which to authenticate to a MongoDB database that uses authentication. Use in conjunction with the --password and --authenticationDatabase options

--verbose.Name: --verbose
--verbose.description: Increases the verbosity of the shell output during the connection process and when running commands

-h.Name: -h
-h.description: Returns information on the options and use of the MongoDB Shell

-p.Name: -p
-p.description: Specifies a password with which to authenticate to a MongoDB database that uses authentication. Use in conjunction with the --username and --authenticationDatabase options

-u.Name: -u
-u.description: Specifies a username with which to authenticate to a MongoDB database that uses authentication. Use in conjunction with the --password and --authenticationDatabase options
